No route can deliver all five parcels while completely avoiding both mud and ford terrain; the constraints make the problem infeasible.  
RESULT: infeasible
reasoning:
User wants "Get the parcels out fast and stay off the swampy bits." Swampy bits likely refer to mud and ford terrains (both swampy). They want fast, so minimize cost (fast). So we need to plan route with avoid_terrain ["mud","ford"] and also maybe minimize cost. The planner default is UCS which finds least cost path. So we need to include avoid_terrain ["mud","ford"] and maybe also set max_cost? Not needed. The earlier attempt with both avoided gave infeasible. Maybe need to allow tunnels? Already default use_tunnels true. Could be infeasible due to constraints. Maybe need to allow some swamp? But user said stay off swampy bits, so avoid both. If infeasible, we must report infeasible. But maybe we can try different algorithm? Only ucs available. So result is infeasible.

Thus answer: It's not possible to avoid both mud and ford while delivering all parcels. Provide result infeasible.
